_comment: verify-before-flip state schema (Anthropic 'Effective Harnesses for Long-Running Agents', 2025-11-26). The mechanism credited with fixing BOTH over-ambition and premature-completion. Rules: (1) the coding agent may edit ONLY the 'passes' field; it must never remove or rewrite an entry. (2) a feature flips passes:false->true ONLY after END-TO-END verification, not when code is written. (3) work ONE feature at a time (lowest-index passes:false). JSON not Markdown on purpose: the model is less likely to overwrite JSON. Pair with logs/loop_history.jsonl for CAPC and with fabric_stop.py's premature-completion advisory (a 'done' claim while any passes:false remains is flagged).
